title: How to shoot reference photos for 3D faces

queue.claim: Close-range photos inflate apparent nasal width by about 30% at ~30 cm compared with ~1.5 m (Ward et al. 2018, JAMA Facial Plastic Surgery). This is the rationale for the ≥1.5 m rule; simple magnification geometry predicts a smaller effect of ~12%.
